gpuBlackMarket.threshold: Premium falling = sanctions leaking; Premium rising = bottleneck tightening

gpuBlackMarket.note: No new premium data this cycle; H100 stable at 2-3x, B200 racks ~50% premium. chinaAiAdoption.value: 541M visits/mo (DeepSeek, #5 globally) · DeepSeek V4 released · 500K+ devs on 通义 · 200+ enterprise deployments (文心)
chinaAiAdoption.value_zh: DeepSeek月访5.41亿次（全球第5）· DeepSeek V4发布 · 通义灵码50万+开发者 · 文心200+企业落地
chinaAiAdoption.threshold: Monitor: daily token volume growth, enterprise case count acceleration
chinaAiAdoption.threshold_zh: 关注：日均Token量增速、企业案例加速曲线
chinaAiAdoption.note: DeepSeek releases official V4-Flash model as China's AI race intensifies (Caixin, Jul 31). DeepSeek developing massive AI data center in Inner Mongolia (Japan Times, Aug 1). DeepSeek developing its own AI chip (Reuters, Jul 9). China plans to let top AI firms buy limited Nvidia H200 chips (Reuters/The Information, Jul 9). China's Moonshot, Z.AI, DeepSeek challenging US AI labs — and beating them on cost (Fortune, Jul 27). DeepSeek V4 (Jul 4) comparing favorably with ChatGPT/Claude/Gemini; 541M visits/mo. Xi 'pitches China as AI partner to developing world' at WAIC. Open-weight model shift benefits Chinese cost-efficient approach. Updated 2026-08-02
chinaAiAdoption.note_zh: DeepSeek发布官方V4-Flash模型，中国AI竞赛加剧（财新，7月31日）。DeepSeek在内蒙古建设大规模AI数据中心（日本时报，8月1日）。DeepSeek自研AI芯片（路透，7月9日）。中国计划允许顶级AI公司购买限量Nvidia H200芯片（路透/The Information，7月9日）。中国月之暗面、智谱、DeepSeek挑战美国AI实验室——并在成本上击败它们（财富，7月27日）。DeepSeek V4（7月4日）与ChatGPT/Claude/Gemini对标表现亮眼；月访问5.41亿。习近平在世界AI大会'向发展中国家推介中国AI合作伙伴'。开源权重模型转型利好中国性价比路线。更新于 2026-08-02

aiInferenceVolume.unit: China LLM API inference market size
aiInferenceVolume.unit_zh: 中国大模型API推理市场规模
aiInferenceVolume.threshold: Inference revenue growing faster than training = real economy adoption, not just model-building
aiInferenceVolume.threshold_zh: 推理收入增速超训练=真实经济渗透，不只是建模型
aiInferenceVolume.note: Inference-to-training revenue ratio is the key metric. China inference share rising faster than US at same stage.
aiInferenceVolume.note_zh: 推理/训练收入比是关键指标。中国推理占比增速超过美国同阶段。

aiMilitaryDeployment.value: 300K+ annual drone production · AI C2 in all theater commands · ASW AI systems deployed
aiMilitaryDeployment.value_zh: 年产能30万+无人机 · AI指挥系统覆盖全部战区 · 反潜AI系统已部署
aiMilitaryDeployment.threshold: Watch: autonomous swarm tests, AI-vs-human wargame results, satellite AI edge processing
aiMilitaryDeployment.threshold_zh: 关注：自主蜂群测试、AI vs 人类兵棋推演结果、卫星AI边缘处理
aiMilitaryDeployment.source: PLA public disclosures · Janes · ASPI Critical Technology Tracker
aiMilitaryDeployment.note: aiMilitaryDeployment unchanged — no major new autonomous warfare disclosures this week. Business Insider Africa (Aug 1): US restrictions failed to stop China using American AI to strengthen its military; Beijing expands arms sales across Africa. UK commits £5B to autonomous drones (Tech Times, Jul 1). DOD seeks ~$30B for AI supercomputing in FY2027. AI warfare implications in Hormuz: both US and Iran increasingly using unmanned systems — Iran drones intercepted over Kuwait, US strikes on Iranian drone facilities. Updated 2026-08-02
aiMilitaryDeployment.note_zh: aiMilitaryDeployment不变——本周无重大自主作战新披露。Business Insider Africa（8月1日）：美国限制未能阻止中国利用美国AI强化军事；北京扩大对非洲军售。英国承诺£50亿用于自主无人机（Tech Times，7月1日）。五角大楼寻求2027财年约$300亿用于AI超算。霍尔木兹AI战争影响：美伊均越来越多使用无人系统——伊朗无人机在科威特被拦截，美军打击伊朗无人机设施。更新于 2026-08-02

aiComputePower.value: ~85 GW data center capacity · 35% YoY growth · 8% of national grid
aiComputePower.value_zh: 数据中心容量约85GW · 同比增35% · 占全国电网8%
aiComputePower.threshold: Data center share of national grid >10% = structural demand shift; >15% = bottleneck risk
aiComputePower.threshold_zh: 数据中心占全国电网比值>10%=结构性需求转移；>15%=瓶颈风险
aiComputePower.source: IEA · NEA China · SemiAnalysis DC tracker
aiComputePower.note: S&P 500 ends with first July decline since 2014 (MarketWatch, Jul 31). China DC capacity ~85 GW. Bond market anxiety over AI capex budgets continues (CNBC, Jul 24); Moody's: AI spending threatens credit quality of Amazon, Meta, Alphabet. DeepSeek building massive AI data center in Inner Mongolia (Japan Times, Aug 1) — China domestic compute expansion continues despite export controls. AI distillation/cost-efficiency trend may temper US DC expansion while China builds out. Updated 2026-08-02
aiComputePower.note_zh: 标普500录得2014年以来首次7月下跌（MarketWatch，7月31日）。中国数据中心容量约85GW。债券市场对AI资本支出预算的担忧持续（CNBC，7月24日）；穆迪：AI支出威胁亚马逊、Meta、Alphabet信用质量。DeepSeek在内蒙古建设大规模AI数据中心（日本时报，8月1日）——中国国产算力扩张在出口管制下继续。AI蒸馏/性价比趋势可能抑制美国数据中心扩张，而中国持续建设。更新于 2026-08-02

aiSpaceCapability.value: 75+ orbital launches (2026 YTD) · ~715+ satellites added · Tiangong fully crewed
aiSpaceCapability.value_zh: 2026年迄今75+次轨道发射 · 新增约715+颗卫星 · 天宫满员运行
aiSpaceCapability.threshold: Launch cadence >100/year + 10,000+ satellite constellation = parity with US space AI capability
aiSpaceCapability.threshold_zh: 年发射>100次 + 万颗卫星星座 = 太空AI能力追平美国

aiSpaceCapability.note: NEW LAUNCHES THIS WEEK: Long March 7A 17th flight with classified payload (Tech Times, Jul 29) — TJS fleet stalks US satellites. CAS Space Kinetica 1 15th mission (Tech Times, Jul 25) — monthly rideshare cadence locked in. Qianfan constellation deployment hits 200 satellites (SpaceNews, Jun 5). Long March 10B launch and recovery attempt scheduled (SpaceNews, Jun 25). YTD launches ~75+. SpaceX 13th Starship test Jul 24 deployed 20 Starlink V3 sats. SpaceX developing 'Starmind' orbital data centers. Updated 2026-08-02
aiSpaceCapability.note_zh: 本周新发射：长征七号甲第17次飞行，载荷保密（Tech Times，7月29日）——天枢系列卫星监视美国卫星。中科宇航力箭一号第15次任务（Tech Times，7月25日）——月度拼车发射节奏锁定。千帆星座部署达200颗卫星（SpaceNews，6月5日）。长征十号B发射与回收尝试已排期（SpaceNews，6月25日）。年初至今约75+次发射。SpaceX第13次星舰试飞7月24日部署20颗Starlink V3卫星。SpaceX开发'星脑'轨道数据中心。更新于 2026-08-02

chinaEnergyIntensity.threshold: Sustained -3%+ = AI + manufacturing efficiency offsetting energy costs
chinaEnergyIntensity.threshold_zh: 持续-3%以上=AI+制造效率在抵扣能源成本
chinaEnergyIntensity.note: Carbon Brief (Jun 4): China CO2 climbs 2% in early 2026, driven by AI data center demand & wind/solar curtailment. 15th FYP targets 17% carbon intensity cut by 2030. No new NBS data this cycle. Hormuz crisis → higher oil prices may accelerate China's renewable deployment. DeepSeek massive Inner Mongolia data center adds AI-driven power demand (Japan Times, Aug 1). AI distillation trend could reduce energy intensity faster than expected. Updated 2026-08-02
chinaEnergyIntensity.note_zh: Carbon Brief（6月4日）：中国2026年初CO2排放上升2%，受AI数据中心需求和弃风弃光推动。十五五目标2030年碳强度降低17%。本周期无新统计局数据。霍尔木兹危机→油价上涨可能加速中国可再生能源部署。DeepSeek内蒙古大型数据中心增加AI驱动电力需求（日本时报，8月1日）。AI蒸馏趋势可能使能源强度下降快于预期。更新于 2026-08-02

chinaAiVoiceAgent.value: Qwen Audio Agent 1.77K⭐ (7d) · full-duplex voice · ACP native for Kimi Code/OpenClaw/OpenCode/Hermes
chinaAiVoiceAgent.value_zh: Qwen Audio Agent 1.77K⭐（7天）· 全双工语音 · Kimi Code/OpenClaw/OpenCode/Hermes 原生 ACP
chinaAiVoiceAgent.threshold: Watch: voice-agent runtime adoption outside China; local speech-to-speech v1.3.0 removes cloud dependency
chinaAiVoiceAgent.threshold_zh: 关注：语音Agent运行时海外采纳度；v1.3.0全本地speech-to-speech消除云依赖
chinaAiVoiceAgent.note: NEW: Alibaba QwenAudio released qwen-audio-agent (2026-07-27) — realtime voice runtime for AI agents. Full-duplex voice with natural interruption; foreground conversation runs in parallel with background agent tasks (spawn_thinking → FIFO queue → fixed agent session → natural callback '已经好了'). Supports WebUI/TUI/macOS desktop orb. Native ACP integration: OpenCode/OpenClaw/Qoder/Kimi Code ★★★★★, Hermes ★★★★☆, Codex/Claude Code via external ACP. Local user profile + cross-session memory in ~/.config/qwaudio/. v1.3.0 testing HuggingFace speech-to-speech fully local frontend (VAD/STT/LLM/TTS via mlx-lm) — China data-residency relevant. Apache-2.0. 1.77K⭐/111 forks in 7 days. Updated 2026-08-03
chinaAiVoiceAgent.note_zh: 新：阿里QwenAudio发布qwen-audio-agent（2026-07-27）——AI Agent实时语音运行时。全双工语音+自然打断；前台对话与后台Agent任务并行（spawn_thinking→FIFO队列→固定Agent会话→自然回调'已经好了'）。支持WebUI/TUI/macOS桌面悬浮球。原生ACP接入：OpenCode/OpenClaw/Qoder/Kimi Code ★★★★★，Hermes ★★★★☆，Codex/Claude Code走外部ACP。本地用户档案+跨会话记忆在~/.config/qwaudio/。v1.3.0测试HuggingFace speech-to-speech全本地前台（VAD/STT/LLM/TTS用mlx-lm）——与中国数据不出境要求相关。Apache-2.0。7天1.77K⭐/111 forks。更新于 2026-08-03
